text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japan Dirt Derby.<n>Shinko Windy
endures the heckling<n>from the stands, determined
not to<n>give them the reaction they want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's going to show them how<n>cool she really is
and achieve her<n>ultimate goal, she can't afford to
buckle under their mockery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Elsewhere, a dejected Biko<n>Pegasus—who's been
struggling to<n>improve during her training—watches
Shinko Windy's race on TV.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy ignores the crowd's<n>comments and
boldly enters the<n>paddock. Biko Pegasus wonders
how<n>the race will turn out.
